Description: Creates any simple immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R

Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will "turn off;" when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration of the spell has not expired)
Caster can control the intensity of light within the area of effect. The intensity can vary from daylight to darkness (natural), and it can be different in different parts of the radius
Causes a 10'R burst of intense light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5 failure
A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table
One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has visual appearance altered for the duration of the spell. Note that the no other aspect of the object changes
Creates an area of darkness about the target's head that blinds him. It may be dispelled or cancelled by Utterlight. The area of effect moves with the target
As Light Control I, except area affected is 50'R
Nullifies all magically created darkness in a 100'R, and lights that area as full daylight

All of the terrain in the area of effect will appear differently than it actually does. The caster may designate in what way the terrain appears different. For example, for a group of small trees could be made into a group of tall trees. Note that only the visual aspect of the terrain changes
A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 1 mile long
Darkens a 100'R area, no non-magic light can exist and magic light (except Utterlight) must make an RR)
As Light Control I, except area affected is 100'R
As Shock Bolt I, except range is 300'
As Beacon I, except ray can be up to 5 miles long
As Shock Bolt, except a Lightning Bolt is shot. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table
As Light Control I, except area affected is 500'R
As Lightning Bolt I, except range is 300'
As Light Control I, except area affected is 100'R/lvl. SPECIAL NOTE See Section 7.1.27 for more information on illusions, mirages, etc. ILLUSIONIST BASE LIST 3.3.4 LIGHT MOLDING
